observation.note: The script was run live and again with --block 51445239. Both returned the same fifteen gates and the same PASS.

contracts.note: verifier, settlementToken, facility, owner and attestor are read from the adapter's own immutables at run time, never from a literal.

holderA.provenance: Pre-existing designated positiveHolder, also CCP_PUBLIC_TEST_HOLDER in src/lib/protection/ccp-eligibility.ts. Source: docs/evidence/deployed-release-closure-2026-08-05.json.

holderB.provenance: Newly provisioned for this correction. No qualified second holder had ever been designated: the prior fixture used the negative control as holderB. A fresh Mordant-controlled key was generated and a genuine A-Pass requested through the same /generate_apass route used for the M-08 probe and for the adapter itself.
holderB.keyCustody: MORDANT_KEY_HOLDER_B in the gitignored .env. The key itself is not recorded here and appears in no artifact.

negativeControl.note: No A-Pass was requested for this address. It was previously misused as holderB in docs/evidence/runtime-contract-handoff-2026-08-06.json; that is the defect this artifact corrects, not a state to restore.

facility.source: read from the deployed adapter's facility() immutable

roleCorrection.note: openRoleMask is immutable in the verifier constructor and remains 16, that is ROLE_HOLDER only. The grant is account-specific and confers ROLE_FACILITY on this one address. No adapter redeployment was required.

cureAuthorizationProof.method: eth_call simulation of cure(bytes32) against a run id that does not exist. No transaction was sent.

facilityCaller.reading: The call cleared both authorization checks, msg.sender == facility and _requireEligible(msg.sender, ROLE_FACILITY), and stopped only on the absent case. Before the grant this same call reverted on eligibility.

nonFacilityCaller.reading: The facility check still refuses everyone else, so the grant did not widen who may cure.

settlement.note: Bounded to what the adapter can actually pay. The superseded fixture carried 600000/400000 atomic units, that is 1.0 aUSDC, which is 250 times the funded reserve and would revert with InsufficientReserve.

aUsdcTransferPolicyReadbacks.method: CleanverseAPassVerifier.isAssetTransferAllowed(asset, from, to, amount), which delegates to the live Cleanverse policy canTransfer
aUsdcTransferPolicyReadbacks.supersededClaimCorrection: docs/evidence/recourse-adapter-v2-deployment-2026-08-06.json and docs/evidence/p1-recourse-adapter-deployment-2026-08-06.json both state adapterToHolderB: true with no generator, no addresses and no readback behind it. For the address those files' holderB then resolved to, 0x981F6E0Ea94f45fDB8ee7680DC862212E3C720e0, that claim was false live and false at the V2 deployment block 51386299. The true reading above is for the new holderB only.

notDone: no governed release transaction was submitted
no EIP-712 handoff fixture was regenerated; the deployment-bound domain correction is a separate change
